text_blocks.snippet: Depression is characterized by persistent sadness and loss of interest in activities, accompanied by various physical and emotional symptoms. These symptoms can include changes in appetite or sleep, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, and even thoughts of death or suicide. While occasional sadness is normal, depression is diagnosed when these symptoms persist for at least two weeks and significantly impair daily functioning.
